title: Terence McKenna staying with the Sheldrakes in London
summary: Rupert Sheldrake tells of Terence McKenna staying with the Sheldrakes in London, about an unknown time at London, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Terence was one of my very good friends whenever he was in London he stayed with us here

plain: The biologist Rupert Sheldrake tells podcast host Jesse Michels that the writer Terence McKenna was one of his very good friends. He says that whenever McKenna was in London, he stayed with the Sheldrake family at their home. He shares it to show how close he was to McKenna and his ideas.
